scope: Read-only audit of a missing paper preprocessing component; no install, execution, dataset modification or training authorized by this artifact
confirmed_source_facts: The official repository has config/waymo/waymo0.yaml and waymo1.yaml, dataset=2, and detector_waymo.launch selects waymo1.yaml.
The node consumes local point clouds plus odometry; TimerCallback dequeues corresponding cloud/rotation/translation/time and calls DynObjFilter::filter.
The filter accepts undistorted local XYZ points, rotation, translation and scan_end_time. It computes world points as R*p_body+t and assigns scan_end_time to the points in this frame callback.
The node pairs FIFO queues rather than validating stamp equality; an adapter must ensure an exact one-cloud/one-pose pairing before use.
The public configuration is a Waymo implementation starting point, not evidence of DrivingEditor authors' exact configuration or input sensor choice.
future_minimum_adapter_checks: Bind the existing silver-car raw segment and original record order; do not substitute labelled boxes as detector output.
Define input LiDAR sensors/returns, native metric scale, sensor/body/world coordinate transforms and deskew status from actual Waymo calibration/poses.
Retain mapping from detector labels to each original point index and timestamp; prove no crop/resample/reorder silently breaks this mapping.
Run detector in an isolated dependency environment; do not replace current CUDA/PyTorch/compiler or edit shell profiles using README examples.
Keep body-mask and shadow changes separate. Compare initialization point assignments before a separately registered from-zero experiment.
current_paper_reproduction_gap: M-detector initialization is still absent. This is a known component mismatch, not by itself proof that it caused the current separation failure.
